name: Role-based permission covers domain, classification and access type
remediation: Raise a role change through IAM if the business need is legitimate.
description: The employee's role must hold a permission for the asset's data domain at or above the asset's classification level, including the requested access type.

name: Administrative access requires a privileged role
remediation: Route through the privileged access management (PAM) process.
description: Admin access is restricted to roles flagged as privileged and subject to quarterly privileged-access review.

name: Requester must be an active employee
remediation: Disable the identity in the directory, revoke all entitlements and investigate the leaver process failure.
description: Terminated identities must not be able to raise or hold access. A request from a terminated identity indicates a joiner-mover-leaver control failure.

name: Data protection training is current
remediation: Enrol the employee in mandatory data protection training and confirm completion.
description: Employees accessing Internal or higher data must have completed data protection training within the configured window.

name: No segregation-of-duties conflict
remediation: Request access through an independent function or obtain a documented SoD waiver.
description: Certain roles may not access domains that independently monitor or control their own activity.

name: Write, export and admin access need a change ticket
remediation: Attach an approved ticket reference to the request.
description: Elevated access types must reference an approved ServiceNow ticket (RITM/CHG).

name: Line manager approval
remediation: Obtain line manager approval.
description: Access to Internal data or above requires line manager approval.

name: Data owner approval for Confidential and Restricted data
remediation: Obtain approval from the asset's accountable data owner.
description: The accountable data owner must approve access to Confidential or Restricted assets.

name: DPO approval for special category data and non-adequate transfers
remediation: Obtain DPO approval and record the lawful basis.
description: The Data Protection Officer must approve access to special category personal data, and any access that exposes personal data to a jurisdiction without an adequacy decision.

name: Approvals are recent
remediation: Re-obtain the stale approvals.
description: Approvals older than the configured window are treated as stale.

name: Asset is classified
remediation: Classify the asset under the Data Classification Standard.
description: Every data asset must carry a classification. Unclassified assets are treated as Restricted for decisioning.

name: Asset has an accountable data owner
remediation: Assign an accountable data owner and record it in the asset register.
description: Every data asset must have a named accountable owner who can approve access.

name: Encryption at rest for Confidential and Restricted data
remediation: Enable storage-level encryption with managed keys and evidence it.
description: Confidential and Restricted assets must be encrypted at rest.

name: Retention period not exceeded
remediation: Run the retention purge for records beyond the retention period, with legal-hold checks.
description: Records older than the asset's retention period should have been deleted or archived.

name: Data residency restriction
remediation: Access must be performed by local staff, or the data must be anonymised before use elsewhere.
description: Assets flagged as residency-required may only be accessed by staff located in the asset's own jurisdiction.

name: Cross-border access needs adequacy or a valid transfer mechanism
remediation: Execute or renew the transfer mechanism and complete a transfer impact assessment (TIA).
description: Remote access to personal data is a transfer. Where the employee's jurisdiction has no adequacy status for the data's jurisdiction, a valid, unexpired transfer mechanism (SCCs, IDTA, intra-group agreement) with a transfer impact assessment is required.

name: Banking secrecy for client identifying data
remediation: Use pseudonymised extracts or local staff for the activity.
description: Client identifying data (CID) held in strict banking-secrecy jurisdictions may not be accessed from outside that jurisdiction.

name: No cross-border export of Restricted personal data
remediation: Use an aggregated or anonymised dataset, or perform the analysis in-region.
description: Bulk export of Restricted personal data to a different jurisdiction is prohibited.

name: Purpose limitation
remediation: Register the new purpose (with DPO review) or use a dataset registered for this purpose.
description: The stated purpose must be one of the asset's registered processing purposes.

name: Third-party hosting has a processor agreement
remediation: Execute a processor agreement (GDPR Art. 28) and add it to the register of information.
description: Assets hosted by a third party must reference a processor agreement registered in the DORA register of information.
